A '''Jedi Knight''' was the former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Silvarte]] who had achieved the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The Padawan possessed a particularly lumbering stance in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], leading Silvarte to refer to the student as one of the devotees of the "Way of the [[Guid]]"&mdash;a hulking quadruped native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. The Padawan took Silvarte's mockery to heart, developing several [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] techniques after studying and observing the guids on Tython, and the Jedi was eventually proclaimed to be a full Jedi Knight.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi Knight was first mentioned in the Codex entry for the guid in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
